_comment: Sample Supabase contents for tools/segment_pull.py (Phase 3). Verifies segmentation + consent-gated roster hashing with NO live creds. Mirrors the column shape of public.subscriptions / public.events / public.feedback / public.marketing_consent; `auth_users` simulates the GoTrue admin user->email map (only used to test the hashed-roster path offline — never a real table). Designed so each segment is non-empty and mostly non-overlapping: u1 checkout-abandoner, u2 power-still-free + promoter, u3 free-not-converted, u4 pro purchaser + promoter, u5 free-not-converted + detractor, u6 starter purchaser (control). `marketing_consent` exercises every consent path: u1/u2 granted (upload rosters; each is 1 match -> below_match_floor warning), u4 consented->withdrawn (promoters REMOVAL roster, Meta §4), u5 phantom opt-out (consent_at null + withdrawn_at set -> excluded, NOT a removal target), u3/u6 no row (u3 excluded; u6 in no segment). Two anonymous PageViews exercise anon_skipped; PageView/ViewContent rows test the NON_ENGAGED exclusion. Not real data.
